title: mcpload report
description: report.json written by the mcpload CLI. schemaVersion "1". Additive changes keep the major version; consumers MUST ignore unknown properties.

tool.description: The program that wrote the report.

protocol.description: Protocol actually negotiated (resolved from 'auto'), e.g. '2025-06-18' or '2026-07-28'.

git.description: Git revision of the system under test, when known (e.g. from CI).

generator.description: Resource usage of the load generator (the k6 process). Percentages are the share of the machine's total CPU capacity (all cores), 0..100; null when not measured. cpuAvgPct averages over the whole k6 lifetime (including an idle cool-down); cpuMaxPct is the busiest full sampling interval.

phases.description: Phase boundaries in seconds since run start. Warm-up is [0, warmupEndS), constant load [warmupEndS, loadEndS), cool-down (zero load) [loadEndS, cooldownEndS]. Scenarios without phases set warmupEndS = 0 and cooldownEndS = loadEndS.

byErrorType.description: mcp_errors broken down by the error_type tag. Keys not in the known list are allowed (forward compatibility).

droppedIterations.description: Iterations k6 could not start on schedule (k6 'dropped_iterations' counter; arrival-rate executors).

tools.description: Per-tool statistics over tools/call requests (mcp_req_duration{method:tools/call} grouped by the tool tag). Latencies in milliseconds, computed over successful calls only; errors and errorRate count every failed call.

thresholds.description: k6 threshold results, one entry per expression.

observed.description: Observed value of the aggregation in expr (ms for durations, 0..1 for rates, raw for counts). null when there were no samples.

series.description: Time series as parallel arrays. Every array has the same length as t. null marks a missing sample.

t.description: Bucket timestamps, seconds since run start.

rssBytes.description: Resident memory. Empty array when sampler is 'none'.

tools.description: Per-tool client series keyed by tool name. Arrays are parallel to t.

p95Ms.description: p95 of successful tools/call latency per bucket, ms.

payloadsIncluded.description: True only when the CLI ran with --include-payloads. Tool arguments/results are otherwise absent from the report.

workflow.description: Multi-step agent workflows (scenario agent-workflow), from the k6 custom metrics mcp_workflow_complete, mcp_workflow_duration and mcp_workflow_step_duration{step}. Absent when the run emitted none.

durationMs.description: End-to-end duration of complete workflows: connect to the end of the last step, think pauses included.

steps.description: Per step, in plan order: wall time of the step's parallel batch of calls (its slowest call).

capacity.description: Step-load runs only: per-step results and the breaking point (verdict 'capacity'). Each step covers the requests made while k6 held that concurrency (tag step=<vus>); ramps between steps are left out.

plannedVus.description: Concurrency levels the scenario planned, in order. steps may stop short (stoppedEarly).

maxSustainableVus.description: Last step before the first breach (the highest step when none broke); null when the first step broke.

breakingVus.description: First step that crossed a budget; null when none did.

inconclusive.description: The load generator was saturated at the breaking step, so the breach may be k6's own overhead.

stoppedEarly.description: The scenario stopped the run once a step broke badly (ABORT_ERR_RATE).

budgets.description: Budgets each step was judged against.

steps.description: One entry per step that produced requests, sorted by vus.

sessions.description: Long-lived sessions (scenario long-lived, metric mcp_session_lifetime) and how they ended (verdict 'session_survival').

survived.description: Sessions that stayed open until their planned end.

died.description: Sessions that ended early: session_not_found, or rounds of transport errors only.

diedByCause.description: Deaths by error type; sums to died.

diedAfterS.description: Median lifetime (s) of the sessions that died; null when none did.

driftTool.description: Tool whose p95 rose most from early to late in the sessions (absent without enough calls).

earlyP95Ms.description: driftTool p95 of successful calls in the first third of the sessions.

lateP95Ms.description: driftTool p95 of successful calls in the last third of the sessions.

chaos.description: A fault mcpload injected during the run (--chaos-restart): docker restart of one named container.

ran.description: False when the run ended before the restart was due.

atS.description: When docker restart started, seconds since run start.

error.description: Why docker restart failed (recovery is then not measured).

recovery.description: How the server and its clients came back (verdict 'recovery'). Times are seconds after atS.

recoveryS.description: Start of the first windowS-long window with requests served, an error rate (tool_iserror left out) below errorRate and a connect p95 below connectP95Ms; null when never.

serverBackS.description: First successful connect after the first error.

lastReconnectS.description: Last reconnect of an agent whose session broke.

connectAttempts.description: Connects from atS to the end of the recovery window (the flood).

errorsByType.description: Errors other than tool_iserror over the same span.

callIntegrity.description: Per call id (params._meta "io.mcpload/callId"): what the client saw against what the server executed (--calls-url; verdict 'call_integrity').

source.description: Where the server's record of executions came from.

retried.description: Call ids the client sent more than once (retry, double send).

clientFailed.description: Call ids whose every attempt failed on the client; = failedButExecuted + neverRan.

executed.description: Call ids the server ran at least once.

failedButExecuted.description: Failed on the client, ran on the server.

neverRan.description: Failed on the client, never ran.

duplicated.description: Call ids the server ran more than once.

duplicatedAfterRetry.description: Duplicated ids the client had sent more than once.

latency.description: Latency of a set of durations in milliseconds; all zero when count is 0.

load.description: Load shape configuration as passed to k6.

arrivalRate.description: Iterations (agent sessions) started per arrivalTimeUnitS during constant load.

vus.description: Concurrency (k6 VUs = agents) held during the step.

startS.description: First and last tagged sample of the step, seconds since run start.

connectP95Ms.description: p95 of successful session starts; null without one.

connectErrorRate.description: Share of failed session starts; null without any.

generatorCpuMaxPct.description: Busiest k6 CPU sampling interval within the step, % of the machine.

breaches.description: Every breach in words, worst first.

p95.description: Successful calls only; null without one.

signal.description: Path of the series (or metric) the verdict is computed from, e.g. 'server.rssBytes', 'client.p95Ms', 'mcp_errors{error_type:session_not_found}'.

slopePerMin.description: Linear-regression slope over the constant-load window, in the signal's unit per minute (bytes/min for rssBytes).

baseline.description: Post-warm-up baseline of the signal, in the signal's unit.

cooldownRecovered.description: Whether the signal returned near baseline during cool-down.
